prompt:
Research the officially documented limits of Supabase's free plan (database size, monthly active users, file storage, project pausing). Cite Supabase's own page and quote the limits.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Based on the official Supabase documentation, here are the documented limits for the Free plan:

SOURCE: https://supabase.com/pricing | QUOTE: "Free projects are paused after 1 week of inactivity. Limit of 2 active projects." | CLAIM: Free plan projects are paused after 1 week of inactivity, with a limit of 2 active projects.
SOURCE: https://supabase.com/pricing | QUOTE: "500 MB database size (Shared CPU • 500 MB RAM)" | CLAIM: The free plan includes a limit of 500 MB database size per project.
SOURCE: https://supabase.com/pricing | QUOTE: "50,000 monthly active users" | CLAIM: The free plan includes a limit of 50,000 monthly active users.
SOURCE: https://supabase.com/pricing | QUOTE: "1 GB file storage" | CLAIM: The free plan includes a limit of 1 GB of file storage.
SOURCE: https://supabase.com/docs/guides/platform/billing-faq | QUOTE: "You are entitled to two active free projects. Paused projects do not count towards your quota." | CLAIM: The free plan allows two active projects, and paused projects do not count toward this limit.
SOURCE: https://supabase.com/docs/guides/platform/billing-faq | QUOTE: "No, we do not charge for paused projects. Compute hours are only counted for active instances. Paused projects do not incur any compute usage charges." | CLAIM: Paused projects on the free plan do not incur any charges.
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: None. All requested limits (database size, monthly active users, file storage, project pausing) were found and cited from Supabase's official pages.
